name: Ca chinh song Son
summary: Son River eel, firm and naturally sweet. Grilled is the classic, rich and lightly spicy, and it is also cooked um or kho, or steamed.
origin: The Son River at Phong Nha.
texture: The flesh is firm and naturally sweet.
taste: Grilled eel is rich and lightly spicy.
howToEat: Start with it grilled. The other ways are um, kho, and steamed.
where: The Son River at Phong Nha.
seoTitle: Ca chinh song Son — eel from the Son
seoDescription: Son River eel at Phong Nha is firm and naturally sweet. Try it grilled, rich and lightly spicy, or cooked um, kho, or steamed.
